_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley Dialogue-MarriageDialogueKrobus.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Japanese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "japanese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, reading, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "japanese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

Bad_1.japanese: （ハァ）...たぶん僕は、自身の種類でとどまったはずなんだ。$s
Bad_1.english: (Sigh)... Probably I should have stayed with my own kind.

Bad_2.japanese: 僕と一緒に暮らすことが楽しい？$s
Bad_2.english: Are you having fun living together with me?

Bad_4.japanese: 君は別の人間と生活する方が幸せになると思うよ...$s
Bad_4.english: I think you'd be happier living with a different human...

Bad_5.japanese: 君の行動の変化を見つけたよ...それはどういう意味？（う～ん）$s
Bad_5.english: I found a change in your behavior... what does that mean? (Mmm)

Bad_6.japanese: 君は短い一生しか生きることができない...僕のような恐ろしい生き物と一緒に過ごしたい？$s
Bad_6.english: You can only live a short lifetime... do you want to spend it with a frightening creature like me?

Bad_7.japanese: たぶん、こんな関係はうまくいかない運命だよ...$s
Bad_7.english: Maybe a relationship like this is fated not to go well...

Good_0.japanese: 僕たちは進歩してる、だから本当に希望を感じてるんだ。$h
Good_0.english: We're making progress, so I really feel hopeful.

Good_1.japanese: 自分の体に感覚がるよ...これは...「プラトニックラブ」？$l#$b#...おー、ちょっと待って...僕は脱皮しているだけ。$s
Good_1.english: I have a sensation in my body... is this... "platonic love"? ...Oh, wait a moment... I'm just shedding my skin.

Good_2.japanese: 人間に対する偏見を克服することを学んだんだ...でもドワーフはまだ私を嫌悪してる。$a
Good_2.english: I learned to overcome my prejudice toward humans... but dwarves still disgust me.

Good_3.japanese: 君は夜中に僕を軽く叩き始めた、そして、「ブラックなめかish」について混乱し始めた...それはどういう意味？$3
Good_3.english: In the middle of the night you started lightly patting me, and started getting muddled about "black namekaish"... what does that mean?

segments.gloss: in the middle of the night

Good_5.japanese: ちょうどこの素敵な家を誉めていたところだよ...なんて素晴らしい場所なんだ。$l
Good_5.english: I was just admiring this lovely house... what a wonderful place it is.

Indoor_Day_0.japanese: あなたを助けることができるなら、そうする...でも家をきちんと保つために最善を尽くすよ。
Indoor_Day_0.english: If I can help you, I'll do it... but I'll do my best to keep the house tidy.

Indoor_Day_1.japanese: 人間の食べ物を作るために最善を尽くしたよ...[203 204 651 225]#$e#後で食べることができるから心配しないで...
Indoor_Day_1.english: I did my best to make human food... Don't worry, since you can eat it later...

Indoor_Day_2.japanese: 私はここに、家の中にいれて幸せ。素敵な場所でぜんぶの時間を過ごすのが好きです...人間のように「外に出る」必要がないんだ。#$e#でも、君がやらなきゃいけないことがあることを理解してる！一緒にここにいなきゃいけないなんて、思わないで。$3
Indoor_Day_2.english: I'm happy that I can be here, in the house. I like spending all my time in a lovely place... I don't need to "go outside" like humans. But I understand that you have things you have to do! Don't think that you have to stay here with me.

Indoor_Day_3.japanese: 目を覚まして、隅っこに留まって一日を過ごすことを考えてるよ...#$e#なに？そうしないっていうこと？$3
Indoor_Day_3.english: I'm thinking of waking up and spending the day staying in the corner... What? You mean you don't do that?

Indoor_Day_4.japanese: 金曜日は、ヨーバを尊重して静かに過ごしたいな。気にしないで。
Indoor_Day_4.english: On Fridays I want to spend it quietly out of respect for Yoba. Don't mind it.

Indoor_Day_Krobus.japanese: 農場であなたを助けることができればいいけど、太陽の下に出ることはできないの...
Indoor_Day_Krobus.english: I wish I could help you on the farm, but I can't go out under the sun...

Indoor_Night_0.japanese: 今日家の外ですべてのバグを掃除したよ...ごめん、君を救わなかった！（ピシャリ）$7
Indoor_Night_0.english: Today I cleaned up all the bugs outside the house... sorry, I didn't save you any! (Smack)

Indoor_Night_1.japanese: しっかりしてると感じてる...時々自分にも骨があったらいいのにって思うよ...$s
Indoor_Night_1.english: I feel you're solid... sometimes I think it'd be nice if I had bones too...

Indoor_Night_2.japanese: 時々、人間と影の人たちが本当に共存できるのかって思う...それは素晴らしい考えだよ、でもそれは現実的なのかな？$s#$e#そう願ってるよ...
Indoor_Night_2.english: Sometimes I wonder whether humans and the shadow people can really coexist... That's a wonderful idea, but is it realistic? I hope so...

Indoor_Night_3.japanese: 時々君から人間について学んだこと、それをすべて一旦止めて考えるんだ...#$b#すべての仲間の影の人たちが、この気持ちを知ってくれることを願ってる。
Indoor_Night_3.english: Sometimes I stop everything for a moment and think about the things I've learned about humans from you... I hope all my fellow shadow people get to know this feeling.

Indoor_Night_4.japanese: 君にとって良い同居人になりたいけど、うまくやっているかどうかわからない...（う～ん）$s#$e#人間の表現を理解するのに苦労してるよ。で...でも...きみは僕と一緒に暮らして幸せ？#$e#オーケー！$7
Indoor_Night_4.english: I want to be a good housemate for you, but I don't know whether I'm doing well... (Mmm) I struggle to understand human expressions. B... but... are you happy living with me? Okay!

Indoor_Night_Krobus.japanese: ハイ、@。わが家へようこそ。今まで一生懸命働いてきたようですね！$h
Indoor_Night_Krobus.english: Hi, @. Welcome to our home. It looks like you've worked hard until now!

Neutral_0.japanese: 二度と年を取ることはないけど、君は年を取るでしょう。時々悲しくなる...でも大丈夫。$s
Neutral_0.english: I will never grow old again, but you will grow old. Sometimes I get sad... but it's okay.

Neutral_1.japanese: 君のおじいちゃんは家に住んでいるモンスターを許すと思う？
Neutral_1.english: Do you think your grandpa would forgive a monster living in the house?

Neutral_2.japanese: 僕たちが一緒に暮らすことで困ったことがあったと思う？$s
Neutral_2.english: Do you think there's been trouble because we live together?

Neutral_3.japanese: ここはとても明るいよ...僕は数時間目を閉じるよ。$s
Neutral_3.english: It's very bright here... I'll close my eyes for a few hours.

Neutral_4.japanese: 外には出られない、僕は特定の食べ物しか食べられない、特定の方法で温度が必要なんだ...一緒に暮らすのが面倒じゃないことを願うよ@。$s
Neutral_4.english: I can't go outside, I can only eat certain foods, I need the temperature a certain way... I hope living together isn't a bother, @.

Neutral_5.japanese: ウェルウィックは、僕は今日呪われていると言ってる。$s
Neutral_5.english: Welwick says that I'm cursed today.

Neutral_6.japanese: 秘密を教えるよ...僕は実際眠らないで、目を閉じてそこに横たわっているだけなんだ...
Neutral_6.english: I'll tell you a secret... I actually don't sleep, I just lie there with my eyes closed...

Neutral_7.japanese: 僕みたいな生き物と一緒に住みたいなんて変な人だ。
Neutral_7.english: You're a strange person to want to live with a creature like me.

Neutral_8.japanese: 一日中家を掃除するつもりだよ！楽しいね。$7
Neutral_8.english: I intend to clean the house all day! It's fun.

Neutral_9.japanese: 僕はここで自分の人生すべてを生きるのかな？移動することはたぶん、僕にとって危険すぎだよ。
Neutral_9.english: Will I live my whole life here, I wonder? Moving is probably too dangerous for me.

OneKid_3.japanese: どうやっていいか分からないけど、ヨーバはこの家を「子供」と祝福していたんだ...
OneKid_3.english: I don't know how, but Yoba blessed this house with a "child"...

Outdoor_0.japanese: ここに少しの間いるつもりだけど、僕たちは注意しないと...誰かが近づいてきたら隠れなきゃ！
Outdoor_0.english: I intend to be here for a little while, but we have to be careful... if someone approaches I'll have to hide!

Outdoor_1.japanese: 外に出られるのはたまにだね！
Outdoor_1.english: I only get to go outside once in a while!

Outdoor_2.japanese: なんて美しい日だろう！$h
Outdoor_2.english: What a beautiful day it is!

Outdoor_3.japanese: 広々としたスペースが僕を緊張させる...$s

Outdoor_4.japanese: 君の一日を始めてね、僕はただここにいて家を守るよ。
Outdoor_4.english: Start your day; I'll just be here and guard the house.

Outdoor_Krobus.japanese: ここで少しだけ待って、バグが僕のところに発生するかどうか確かめてね。#$e#まだ朝食を食べてないんだ！
Outdoor_Krobus.english: Wait here just a little and check whether bugs appear by me. I haven't eaten breakfast yet!

Rainy_Day_0.japanese: 私と同じくらい雨の日が好きなんですか@？
Rainy_Day_0.english: Do you like rainy days as much as I do, @?

Rainy_Day_1.japanese: 私たちはいろんな点で違うよ…でも大丈夫。
Rainy_Day_1.english: We're different in lots of ways... but it's okay.

Rainy_Day_2.japanese: おはよう、@。早く出発して、あなたのためにこれを見つけたの。[305 308 203 795 397]#$e#それがあまり奇妙じゃないことを願ってる。
Rainy_Day_2.english: Good morning, @. I set out early and found this for you. I hope it isn't too strange.

Rainy_Day_3.japanese: 魔術師が知ってるのかな...これ？彼が秘密を守れることを願ってます。$s
Rainy_Day_3.english: I wonder if the wizard knows... about this? I hope he can keep a secret.

Rainy_Day_4.japanese: 文明人として振る舞おうと努力しているけど、時々いたずら心が出てきてしまうの。$6#$e#それは私たちの種族の特性なのかもしれない。
Rainy_Day_4.english: I'm trying hard to behave as a civilized person, but sometimes my mischievous side comes out. That might be a trait of our race.

Rainy_Day_Krobus.japanese: あぁ、今日は雨だからもっと湿気がある...私はずっと快適に感じてるわ。
Rainy_Day_Krobus.english: Ah, it's rainy today so it's more humid... I feel much more comfortable.

Rainy_Night_0.japanese: こんな夜に、窓を眺める人がたまに影のような人を見かけるよ。考えてみると…それは私かもしれない。$7
Rainy_Night_0.english: On nights like this, people gazing out windows sometimes see shadow-like people. When I think about it... that might be me.

Rainy_Night_1.japanese: 他の影の人たちが私たちの生活の仕組みを知ったら、彼らは...私を「罰する」と思う。$s#$e#そのほとんどは人間を軽蔑するわ、知ってるとおりね。
Rainy_Night_1.english: If the other shadow people found out how our life works, I think they'd... "punish" me. Most of them despise humans, as you know.

Rainy_Night_2.japanese: 濡れていて、寒い！あなたの種にとって危険じゃないの？$s
Rainy_Night_2.english: You're wet and cold! Isn't that dangerous for your species?

Rainy_Night_3.japanese: もう夕食を食べたけど、あなたが食べられるものはなかったわ...ごめんなさい。
Rainy_Night_3.english: I already ate dinner, but there wasn't anything you could eat... sorry.

Rainy_Night_4.japanese: うちの人たちがいなくなってからずっと、私は新しい家を探してる...いまどこかにいるよ。私にはそれがすべてのことを意味してる。
Rainy_Night_4.english: Ever since I left my people, I've been looking for a new home... now I'm somewhere. To me that means everything.

Rainy_Night_5.japanese: 大きな災害があって、空から霊が物理的な平面に侵入するのを許した時に、人々はずっと前にここに来たと言われているの。
Rainy_Night_5.english: It's said that people came here long ago, when there was a great disaster that allowed spirits from the sky to invade the physical plane.

Rainy_Night_Krobus.japanese: 雨の音を聞くと下水道を思い出すよ...心地がいい。#$e#下水道は私にとっての避難所だったの...そこが安全だと感じてた。でも心配しないで…新しい家も同じように快適だから。
Rainy_Night_Krobus.english: When I hear the sound of the rain it reminds me of the sewers... it's pleasant. The sewers were a refuge for me... I felt it was safe there. But don't worry... because my new home is just as comfortable.

TwoKids_0.japanese: 心配しないで...もう%kid1と%kid2を中身がない卵のオムレツにしました。
TwoKids_0.english: Don't worry... I already made %kid1 and %kid2 into an omelet of eggs with no contents.

TwoKids_2.japanese: 子供たちの将来について心配してるんだ...でも僕は、ヨーバが彼らのための計画していると信じてる。
TwoKids_2.english: I'm worried about the children's future... but I believe that Yoba has plans for them.

TwoKids_3.japanese: この家は今二人の子供に恵まれています...つまり、ヨーバは型にはまらない生活の協定を承認したのかな？
TwoKids_3.english: This house is now blessed with two children... does that mean Yoba approved of our unconventional living arrangement?

fall_15.japanese: 明日自分のグランジディスプレイに何を使うつもりなのか考えた？
fall_15.english: Have you thought about what you intend to use for your grange display tomorrow?

segments.text: グランジディスプレイ

fall_24.japanese: 私がスピリッツ・イブ・フェスティバルに出演した場合、彼らは私を檻の中に入れていたでしょう...$s
fall_24.english: If I appeared at the Spirit's Eve festival, they'd have put me in a cage...

segments.text: スピリッツ・イブ・フェスティバル

fall_8.japanese: 今日は何もしたくない。
fall_8.english: I don't want to do anything today.

fall_Krobus.japanese: カビ臭くて、最近は少し涼しく感じる。人はこの時期を「秋」と呼ぶんだよね？
fall_Krobus.english: It smells musty, and lately it feels a little cool. People call this season "autumn", right?

spouseRoom_Krobus.japanese: #$c .5#僕たちは物理的に違いがあるから、一緒に暮らすのは難しいよね？#$e#ここの湿度が邪魔にならないことを願ってる。二人で一緒に暮らすために妥協することも必要！
spouseRoom_Krobus.english: We're physically different, so living together is hard, isn't it? I hope the humidity here doesn't get in your way. Compromising in order for the two of us to live together is necessary too!

spring_1.english: Your plans for the new year, @?

spring_23.japanese: 明日はフラワーダンスに行こう！心配しないで。
spring_23.english: Let's go to the Flower Dance tomorrow! Don't worry.

spring_Krobus.japanese: 今は「春」ですよね？野生の西洋ワサビの唐辛子の香りを嗅ぐことができるんだ。
spring_Krobus.english: It's "spring" now, isn't it? I can smell the peppery scent of wild horseradish.

summer_1.japanese: すごく簡単に日焼けするから、この時期に注意する必要があるんだ。
summer_1.english: I get sunburned really easily, so I need to be careful this season.

summer_15.japanese: 夏だよ…それは家がハエでいっぱいだということを意味している。#$e#心配しないで、その世話をするよ。良いタンパク質だよ！$h
summer_15.english: It's summer... that means the house is full of flies. Don't worry, I'll take care of it. It's good protein!

summer_8.japanese: うーん...その素敵な香りは何？あなたは一晩中汗をかいていたにちがいないね...$h
summer_8.english: Mmm... what's that lovely smell? You must have been sweating all night...

summer_Krobus.japanese: 人はこの時期を「夏」と呼ぶんだよね？暖かさと湿度は素晴らしいけど、そんなに晴れてないことを望むよ。
summer_Krobus.english: People call this season "summer", right? The warmth and humidity are wonderful, but I hope it won't be so sunny.

winter_28.japanese: ここにいてくれてありがとう、@。私は別の素晴らしい年を楽しみにしてる！$h
winter_28.english: Thank you for being here, @. I'm looking forward to another wonderful year!

winter_Krobus.japanese: 今年のこの時期の薄暗さはすごく穏やかだよ。暖かいだけなら！
winter_Krobus.english: The dimness of this time of year is really calm. If only it were warm!
